basic_profile.bio: Based in São Paulo, Brazil, I am a 28-year-old software engineer with a passion for technology and philosophical discussions. I enjoy reading about atheism and engaging in constructive debates about religion and technology. Outside of work, I love exploring new gadgets and payment technologies like SamsungPay. My evenings are spent online, typically between 7 PM and midnight. I'm in a long-distance relationship, which has allowed me to explore various facets of communication and trust. I dislike misinformation and overly aggressive online behavior.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of São Paulo, I've worked for several tech companies, focusing on software development and systems engineering. My interest in atheism and philosophy is a personal pursuit, driven by a desire to understand different worldviews and ethical systems.
